THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.0-0r.an: Hm...? A strange face enters the stage.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.0-1r.an: You were to feature not in [sine]this[/sine] grand design.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.0-1r.ch: What is this? Some sorcerous trick?!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.1-0r.an: Fascinating. One not of this world, nor even of this plane.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.1-1r.an: And yet, somehow, the Accursed has managed to enthrall you to her will.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.1-2r.an: What false hopes did she ply you? Escape? Understanding?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.1-1r.ch: If this is the world beyond, I have passed through the inferno!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.1-0r.ch: Tell me! Where is he?! [jitter]Bring him back to me![/jitter]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.2-0r.an: I owe you naught. Not an explanation, nor condolences.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.2-1r.an: Although perhaps I could extend to you my pity.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.4-1r.an: My powers are insufficient to allow for reunion.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DEVOUT-DEVOUT.4-2r.an: And so, we arrive at an empasse.
